Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We bought his grill 2 months ago and are extremely thrilled with its performance. It’s easy to use, gets hot fast and is easy to keep a steady temperature. I do wish it had a really low temperature setting as I can’t keep it much below 350 without turnung one burner off. But it’s not too much of an inconvenience since you can just open the lid for a minute. The best thing about this grill is it’s fuel efficiency! I have been on pretty much an empty tank for a month and it won’t quit! Love this grill!
Results.Title: Very fuel efficient

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Have used my barbeque twice so far, and lighting it was easy with the push button ignition. It will take a few uses to get used to the temperature regulation, but it was great for getting hot quickly and cooking on the cast iron grates is a breeze, especially with the silicone mats I use.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Spirit 2!  I bought the 3 burner last year for my main home. Loved it so much I had to get this 2 burner one for my vacation home.
Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
When my old grill rusted out, I decided to go for a slightly smaller Weber grill. I was hoping that the premium price would translate into better quality, and so far I’ve been correct. 
The electric igniter always works. 
The grill temperature is consistent. 
The porcelain coated grated always come clean. 
I also like that when I registered the grill, I now get emails with recipes, grilling tips and grill care tips. 
So far very satisfied.
Results.Title: Worth the money

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
